---
title: "Intensity Test"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
######################### SETUP ######################################
library(tidyverse)
library(effectsize)
```

# Analysis

```{r}
#################### 1. LOAD & PREPARE RAW DATA #######################

files <- list.files("data", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

raw_dat <- map_dfr(
  files,
  ~ read_delim(.x, delim = ",", show_col_types = FALSE)
) %>%
  # exclude first trial
  filter(as.numeric(Repetition) %in% c(2, 3, 4)) %>%
  # drop ambidextrous participants
  filter(!DominantHand %in% c("Ambidextrous", "ambidextrous", "Ambi", "ambi"))

# Build trial-level data frame: trials
trials <- raw_dat %>%
  mutate(
    id = factor(Participant),

    hand = case_when(
      str_detect(Condition, regex("Left",  ignore_case = TRUE))  ~ "left",
      str_detect(Condition, regex("Right", ignore_case = TRUE))  ~ "right",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    surface = case_when(
      str_detect(Condition, regex("Palm", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "palm",
      str_detect(Condition, regex("Back", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "back",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    orig_intensity = as.numeric(Intensity),

    sensitivity = as.numeric(Intensity),
    sensitivity = if_else(sensitivity == 2, 1, sensitivity),  # recode 2 -> 1

    # now only "Left" or "Right" remain
    dominant_hand = case_when(
      DominantHand %in% c("Right", "right") ~ "right",
      DominantHand %in% c("Left",  "left")  ~ "left",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    ),

    dom_hand = case_when(
      dominant_hand == "right" & hand == "right" ~ "dominant",
      dominant_hand == "right" & hand == "left"  ~ "non_dominant",
      dominant_hand == "left"  & hand == "left"  ~ "dominant",
      dominant_hand == "left"  & hand == "right" ~ "non_dominant",
      TRUE                                       ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(id, Repetition, hand, surface,
         orig_intensity, sensitivity, dom_hand) %>%
  mutate(
    hand        = factor(hand,    levels = c("left", "right")),
    surface     = factor(surface, levels = c("palm", "back")),
    dom_hand    = factor(dom_hand, levels = c("dominant", "non_dominant")),
    sensitivity = as.numeric(sensitivity),
    id          = factor(id)
  )

#################### 2. AGGREGATED DATAFRAME FOR ANOVA/VIZ (df) ######
# One row per id × dom_hand × surface (mean over reps 2 & 3)

df <- trials %>%
  group_by(id, dom_hand, surface) %>%
  summarise(
    sensitivity = mean(sensitivity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups     = "drop"
  )

#################### 3. 2×2 REPEATED-MEASURES ANOVA ##################

fit <- aov(
  sensitivity ~ dom_hand * surface + Error(id / (dom_hand * surface)),
  data = df
)

summary(fit)

eta_squared(fit, partial = TRUE)

#################### 4. CONDITION MEANS (IN %) #######################

cond_means <- df %>%
  group_by(dom_hand, surface) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sens_pct = mean(sensitivity, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    sd_sens_pct   = sd(sensitivity, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    n             = n(),
    .groups       = "drop"
  )

cond_means
```


# Boxplot


```{r}
# 4-level condition factor (if not already done)
trials <- trials %>%
  mutate(
    # percentage 0–100
    sensitivity_pct = sensitivity * 100,
    # condition factor in desired order
    condition = factor(
      paste(dom_hand, surface, sep = "_"),
      levels = c("dominant_palm", "non_dominant_palm",
                 "dominant_back", "non_dominant_back")
    )
  )


# One count (misses) per box
counts_2 <- trials %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(
    count_intensity_2 = sum(orig_intensity == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Build x-axis labels with misses included
cond_levels <- levels(trials$condition)

x_labs <- setNames(
  paste0(
    c("Dominant\nPalm\n", "Non-Dominant\nPalm\n", "Dominant\nBack\n", "Non-Dominant\nBack\n"),
    "\n",
    counts_2$count_intensity_2[match(cond_levels, counts_2$condition)],
    "\nMisses"
  ),
  cond_levels
)

ggplot(trials, aes(x = condition, y = sensitivity_pct, fill = dom_hand)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 10),
    labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labs) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "dominant"     = "#f39747",
    "non_dominant" = "#1f78b4"
  )) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Intensity (%)",
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial")+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 10),
        aspect.ratio = 1
  )
```


# Interaction Graph


```{r}
summary_df <- df %>%
  group_by(dom_hand, surface) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sens = mean(sensitivity, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,  # to percent
    se_sens   = (sd(sensitivity, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())) * 100,
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = dom_hand, y = mean_sens,
                       group = surface, color = surface)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_sens - se_sens, ymax = mean_sens + se_sens),
    width = 0.1
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "dominant"     = "Dominant",
      "non_dominant" = "Non-Dominant"
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("palm" = "#f39747", "back" = "#1f78b4"),
    labels = c(
      "palm" = "Palm",
      "back" = "Back"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Hand",
    y = "Mean Intensity (%)",
    color = "Surface"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    aspect.ratio = 1   # makes it square-ish
  )
```
